1.note: The scoped current source carries the module/document behavior described above.

2.note: The module additionally owns `FakeRuntime`, its catalog/server constants and recorded launch-call set. This in-memory bridge stand-in holds agents/workspaces across calls, preserves before/after-effect failure scenarios and supplies state/archive/resume plus `agents-live` answers; `unlisted` makes the census incomplete. `GivenToAgentExpectations` derives the data a dispatch gives an agent, but its first-message line comes from the production `artifact_line`, so only the data is independent and the formatting is shared. Launch/status/document-chat suites share the fake, not a live harness or production host.

3.note:
FakeRuntime._agent_create now records a serviceTier only when featureValues actually contains service_tier, separately copies any supplied featureValues map and retains modeId when supplied. This supports permission-feature-only payloads without a service-tier KeyError and exposes submitted choices to the controlled observations. Default-model and idempotent agent-state behavior remain.
